components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action. Appears once per screen. Sage green, white text, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(50% 0.13 152); color: #fff; padding: 13px 26px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(20% 0.012 60 / 0.04); transition: background 0.18s, transform 0.16s, box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(44% 0.13 152); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(50% 0.13 152 / 0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: oklch(84% 0.008 90); color: oklch(62% 0.005 65); cursor: default; transform: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(50% 0.13 152 / 0.12); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative action. Transparent with a stone border, charcoal-mid text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: oklch(44% 0.008 65); padding: 13px 22px; border: 1.5px solid oklch(84% 0.008 90); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: border-color 0.18s, color 0.18s, transform 0.16s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: oklch(62% 0.005 65); color: oklch(20% 0.012 60); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input with a warm stone border that shifts to sage green on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Q2 Website Redesign" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 16px; border: 1.5px solid oklch(84% 0.008 90); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(100% 0 0); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; color: oklch(20% 0.012 60); outline: none; box-shadow: none; transition: border-color 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(62% 0.005 65); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(50% 0.13 152); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(50% 0.13 152 / 0.10); } .ds-input:disabled { background: oklch(91% 0.012 100); color: oklch(62% 0.005 65); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard container. White background, warm stone border, flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Card heading

components.name: Status Badge — Approved
components.description: Displays on approved scope items. Green tint with a check icon. The only colored badge.
components.html: Approved
components.css: .ds-chip-approved { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 100px; background: oklch(94% 0.035 150); color: oklch(34% 0.1 150); border: 1px solid oklch(86% 0.065 150); }

components.description: Displays on pending, draft, or rejected items. Warm stone grey. Never red or orange.

narrative.overview: Worklit's interface feels like a well-organized architect's desk — warm wood, clean blueprints, confident marks. Every element is placed with intention. There is no decoration that doesn't earn its keep. The color palette is warm stone with a single green accent that appears rarely and always carries meaning: approval, sign-off, done. This is a product surface. The design serves the workflow: define deliverables, send for approval, get paid. The interface should recede when the freelancer is in flow and assert itself only at moments of decision.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, one meaning: green = approval
Warm stone neutrals throughout — no pure black, no pure white
Editorial serif headings paired with clean sans body
Flat at rest, subtle elevation on hover
Every interaction provides responsive feedback without performance

rules.name: The Architect's Stamp Rule
rules.body: Sage green is used on ≤10% of any given screen. It appears only where the freelancer needs to take action — approve, sign, submit, create. If every card has a green element, the stamp loses its authority.

rules.name: The No-Red Rule
rules.body: Rejected, deferred, and neutral states use warm stone greys at reduced opacity. Never red, never orange. Green is the only color that carries emotional weight.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display appears only in headings. Never in body text, never in buttons, never in form labels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, elevation). If a card has a shadow at rest, it's wrong.

dos: Do use sage green sparingly — one primary button per screen, one active indicator. The rarity creates the meaning.
Do use warm stone backgrounds everywhere. Cards are white; pages are warm stone. This alone creates hierarchy.
Do pair DM Serif Display headings with DM Sans body. No other fonts.
Do provide responsive feedback — buttons scale on press, cards lift on hover, inputs glow on focus.
Do use borders for card separation at rest. Shadows are for interaction states only.
Do label every status badge with text. Color is never the sole indicator of state.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — collapse all animation durations to near-zero when the user requests it.
donts: Don't use red, orange, or any secondary accent color. Green is the only meaningful signal.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff) anywhere. Every neutral is tinted toward warm stone.
Don't apply DM Serif Display to body text, buttons, labels, or any non-heading element.
Don't use opacity alone for disabled states. Always change the background color explicitly.
Don't animate from scale(0). Nothing in the real world appears from nothing. Start from scale(0.3) or higher.
Don't use transition: all. Specify exact properties.
Don't use cards inside cards. Nested cards are always wrong.
Don't use side-stripe borders. Rewrite with full borders, background tints, or nothing.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as default, or the hero-metric template.
